certificado.titulo: You have finished the course. Your certificate is ready.
certificado.texto: It carries your name and can be checked with a link. Add it to your LinkedIn profile or share it with anyone.

progreso.certificadosTexto: Certificates for the courses you have finished.

referidos.heroTitulo: Earn {percent}% of what each person who joins through your link pays
referidos.heroTexto: Share {academia} with someone who would find it useful. When they pay, part of it is yours.
referidos.inactivoTitulo: There is no invite and earn programme right now
referidos.inactivoTexto: Your academy has not switched it on. If it does, you will see your link and earnings here.
referidos.membresiaRequerida: You need an active membership in the academy to get your link.
referidos.errorEnlace: Could not prepare your link. Try again later.
referidos.nadaALaVenta: The academy has nothing on sale right now. When it does, your link will show up here.
referidos.porProductoTitulo: Or share the link to a specific product
referidos.mensajeCompartir: I recommend {academia}. Join through my link:
referidos.pendiente: Of which {amount} still to be confirmed
referidos.invitadosTexto: You only see their initials and how much they have brought you. Their name and email stay private.
referidos.invitadosVacio: Nobody has joined through your link yet. When someone does, they will show up here.
referidos.invitadosError: We could not load your invitees. Please try again later.
referidos.listaTexto: Each sale you brought in, with its status. No personal details are shown.
referidos.listaVacia: Nothing yet. When someone pays after joining through your link, it will show up here.

pasos.compartesTexto: On WhatsApp, social media or in person.
pasos.entraTexto: They stay linked to you for {days} days after opening it.

ganaPrimerPago.both: {percent}% of their first payment, whether a purchase or a fee.

ganaCadaPago.membership: {percent}% of each fee they pay, for as long as they stay.
ganaCadaPago.both: {percent}% of each purchase and each fee they pay, for as long as they stay.

ganaMeses.courses: {percent}% of each purchase they make during their first {months} months.
ganaMeses.membership: {percent}% of each fee they pay during their first {months} months.
ganaMeses.both: {percent}% of each purchase and each fee they pay during their first {months} months.

referidos.cobro: What you earn is confirmed once the refund period is over and {academia} pays it to you.
referidos.cobroMinimo: What you earn is confirmed once the refund period is over and {academia} pays it to you when you reach {min}.
referidos.cobroODescuento: What you earn is confirmed once the refund period is over. Then you can use it as a discount on your next fee or ask {academia} to pay it to you.
referidos.cobroODescuentoMinimo: What you earn is confirmed once the refund period is over. Then you can use it as a discount on your next fee or, once you reach {min}, ask {academia} to pay it to you.

dudas.cuandoTexto: When someone opens your link. If they pay within the next {days} days, the sale is yours.
dudas.devolucion: What if they ask for a refund?
dudas.devolucionTexto: If they get their money back, your share of that sale is cancelled.
dudas.limiteMeses: You earn during their first {months} months.
dudas.limiteSin: No. As long as they keep paying, you keep earning.

descuento.texto: What is already confirmed can come off your next fee instead of being paid out. Up to {max} per fee.
descuento.boton: Use as a discount on my next fee ({amount})
descuento.hecho: Done. We will take {amount} off your next fee.
descuento.vacio: You have nothing confirmed to take off yet. It will show here once the refund period is over.
descuento.nada: Right now you have nothing to take off your next fee.
descuento.error: We could not apply the discount. Try again: it will not be applied twice.

cobroDinero.texto: {academia} pays what is confirmed by bank transfer. We need your full name, your tax ID and your account. Didacta withholds nothing.
cobroDinero.confirmado: You have {amount} confirmed to be paid.
cobroDinero.nadaConfirmado: You have nothing confirmed to be paid yet.
cobroDinero.minimo: You can request payment once you reach {min}.
cobroDinero.pedido: You requested {amount} on {date}. {academia} will pay it by bank transfer.
cobroDinero.privacidad: They are stored encrypted. {academia} only sees them to pay you.
cobroDinero.error: It could not be sent. Please try again.

tipo.CREDIT_RETURN: Unused discount returned when you cancelled
